stem:
Uma studies pond microalgae that use sunlight to make their own food. Her class discusses oxygen balance, nitrogen in the air, permanent darkness, pollution, food security, and livelihoods.

Why does conserving these microalgae matter?

options.text: They help keep oxygen balance and support food security and livelihoods.
They add nitrogen to the air when they make food using sunlight.
They can keep making their own food using sunlight even in permanent darkness.
Conserving them increases pollution because abundant microalgae cause it.

teacher.key_rationale: Microalgae make food with sunlight, help oxygen balance, and support food security and livelihoods. Nitrogen swaps the gas story. Darkness drops the sunlight condition. Pollution reverses the conservation benefit.
